But here, with the offspring of the substitute of a guilt offering, the principal original consecration is sacrificed as a guilt offering and not as a burnt offering, so it is not right that the offspring be sacrificed as a burnt offering. And though he says according to Rabbi Elazar, about one who designates a female for a burnt offering and it gave birth, that even though the principal is not sacrificed as a burnt offering but grazes, the offspring itself is sacrificed, so too he should have said about the offspring of the substitute of a guilt offering: even though the principal consecration is not sacrificed as a burnt offering, the offspring itself is sacrificed. [So explained] my teacher, the RaMaR.

notes.he: דולדות היינו מותרות:
notes.en: Concede to me at least that the surplus: the offspring are the surplus.

messages.text: And the Rabbis said to him in response that the remainder of the money goes for communal gift offerings.

notes.he: לנדבת יחיד אזלי כדאמרינן בסיפא דפירקין קמא דר' אלעזר סבר דמותרות לנדבת יחיד אזלא ועבדה תמורה ואמרי ליה רבנן (לא) מותרות לנדבת צבור אזלי ועולה הבאה מן המותרות לא עבדה תמורה דאין תמורה בצבור:
notes.en: Goes to an individual’s gift offering: as we say at the end of the first chapter, that Rabbi Elazar holds that surplus goes to an individual’s gift offering and renders a substitute, and the Rabbis say to him: surplus goes to communal gift offerings, and a burnt offering that comes from surplus does not render a substitute, since there is no substitution for a community.

messages.text: Rabbi Elazar says that the offspring itself is offered as a burnt offering only in a case where he designated a female animal as a burnt offering and it gave birth,
messages.quote: the offspring of the substitute itself, no

notes.he: אפילו תימא דר' אלעזר אמר גבי ולד דתמורת אשם דוודאי הוא עצמו לא יקרב ולא קשיא האי דקאמר גבי ולד עולה דהוא עצמו ליקרב משום דאיכא שם עולה על אמו שהרי מצינו עולה נקבה נוהגת בעני בעולת העוף אבל גבי תמורת אשם לא מצינו דומיא דשם עולה על אמו שלא מצינו [שום] נקבה נוהגת באשם הילכך מודה ר' אלעזר דבדמיו אין והוא עצמו לא קרב:
notes.en: Rava said: You may even say that Rabbi Elazar said of the offspring of the substitute of a guilt offering that certainly it itself is not sacrificed, and what he says of the offspring of a burnt offering, that it itself is sacrificed, is no difficulty, because there is burnt offering status on its mother, since we find a female burnt offering for a poor person, in the bird burnt offering. But with the substitute of a guilt offering we find nothing like burnt offering status on its mother, since we do not find [any] female in a guilt offering. Therefore Rabbi Elazar concedes: with its money, yes, but it itself is not sacrificed.

notes.he: ל"א (ורמי דר"א אדר"א) [ולד מיהת כיון דחזי דזכר הוא קריב גופיה]:
notes.en: Another version: [the offspring at least, since it is seen to be a male, is itself sacrificed.]

messages.text: since there is burnt offering status for a bird that is the same sex as its mother.

notes.he: המפריש בהמה לעולה איכא עלה שם עולה דהא לעולה אקדשה ואי משום דנקבה היא אפ"ה שם עולה עלה שהרי מצינו נקבה בעולת העוף ועוד דהא לכשתמכר דמיה עולה דהיינו לשם עולה:
notes.en: Since there is burnt offering status on its mother: one who designates an animal for a burnt offering, burnt offering status is upon it, since he consecrated it for a burnt offering. And if [you object] because it is a female, even so burnt offering status is upon it, since we find a female in the bird burnt offering. And furthermore, when it is sold, its money is a burnt offering, that is, for the sake of a burnt offering.

notes.he: דאיכא שם עולה על אמו לשון רש"י דהא לעולה אקדשה ואי משום דנקבה היא אפילו הכי שם עולה עלה שהרי מצינו נקבה בעולת העוף ועוד דהא דלכשימכרו דמיה עולה דהיינו שם עולה אבל ולד תמורת אשם אין שם עולה עלה דאמו לא היא ולא דמיה עכ"ל ולשון ראשון דשם עולת העוף על אמו אי אפשר להעמידה בסוגיא דלקמן ובמקומו אפרשנה:
notes.en: Rather, with one who designates a female for a burnt offering, since there is burnt offering status on its mother: Rashi’s wording: since he consecrated it for a burnt offering; and if because it is a female, even so burnt offering status is upon it, since we find a female in the bird burnt offering; and furthermore, when they are sold, its money is a burnt offering, that is, burnt offering status. But the offspring of the substitute of a guilt offering has no burnt offering status on it, since its mother has none, neither it nor its money. [End of his words.] And the first explanation, that burnt offering status is on its mother because of the bird burnt offering, cannot stand in the discussion below, and I will explain it in its place.

notes.he: כי קתני מפריש נקבה לעולה וילדה זכר הוא עצמו יקרב עולה דכיון דאיכא שם עולה על אמו כדאמרן נחתא קדושה לגופה ועוד דלא הויא היא עולת חובתו אלא נדבה [דורון] והואיל ומצי פטר נפשיה בעולת העוף כרבי אלעזר בן עזריה דאמר לקמן האומר הרי עלי עולה יביא כבש רבי אלעזר אמר יביא תור או בן יונה (הילכך) נחתה קדושה לגופה [והלכך] ולד נמי קדיש לגופיה וקרבה אבל תמורת אשם דליכא שם אשם על אמו כדאמרינן וכיון דאשם הוי חובתו ולא מצי מייתי נקבה לאשמו ואי מייתי נקבה לאשמו לא קדשה אלא לדמי ולד נמי לא קדיש גופיה אלא ימכר ויביא בדמיו עולה:
notes.en: You may even say Rabbi Elazar: when it is taught, one who designates a female for a burnt offering and it gave birth to a male, it itself is sacrificed as a burnt offering, since there is burnt offering status on its mother, as we said, sanctity descended on its body. And furthermore, it is not his obligatory burnt offering but a voluntary one [a gift]; and since he could discharge himself with a bird burnt offering, as Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya, who says below: one who says “It is incumbent upon me to bring a burnt offering” brings a lamb; Rabbi Elazar says: he brings a turtledove or a young pigeon [the names here appear confused], sanctity descended on its body, [and therefore] the offspring too is sanctified in its body and is sacrificed. But with the substitute of a guilt offering, where there is no guilt offering status on its mother, as we said, and since a guilt offering is his obligation, and he cannot bring a female for his guilt offering, and if he brings a female for his guilt offering it is sanctified only for its value, the offspring too is not sanctified in its body; rather, it is sold and he brings a burnt offering with its money.

messages.text: Continues on 19a: Rava goes on to say that with the offspring of a guilt offering’s substitute, whose mother has no burnt offering status, Rabbi Elazar concedes that a burnt offering is brought with its money but the offspring itself is not sacrificed.
